transcript: ok capacity cleanup: capacity dashboard and five rules deleted; other rules and Agents dashboards preserved; deletion protection restored

apiVersion: 1
deleteRules:
- orgId: 1
  uid: o11y-capacity-warn
- orgId: 1
  uid: o11y-capacity-shed
- orgId: 1
  uid: o11y-capacity-stop
- orgId: 1
  uid: o11y-capacity-exhaustion
- orgId: 1
  uid: o11y-capacity-stale
groups:
- folder: o11y
  interval: 1m
  name: o11y
  orgId: 1
  rules:
  - annotations:
      description: Its scrape fails, or it has sent nothing for 90 seconds. Every
        job down at once points at Alloy, which scrapes them all.
      summary: '{{ $labels.job }} has been down for 5 minutes.'
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: mimir
      model:
        expr: "min by (job) (up{namespace=\"o11y\"} and time() - timestamp(up{namespace=\"\
          o11y\"}) < 90) or max by (job) (rustfs_start_total{job=\"o11y/rustfs\"}\n\
          \  and time() - timestamp(rustfs_start_total{job=\"o11y/rustfs\"}) < 90)\
          \ * 0 + 1\nor label_replace(vector(0), \"job\", \"o11y/alloy\", \"\", \"\
          \") or label_replace(vector(0), \"job\", \"o11y/grafana\", \"\", \"\") or\
          \ label_replace(vector(0), \"job\", \"o11y/loki\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace(vector(0),\
          \ \"job\", \"o11y/mimir\", \"\", \"\") or (label_replace(vector(0), \"job\"\
          , \"o11y/rustfs\", \"\", \"\")\n  and on() count(count_over_time(rustfs_start_total{job=\"\
          o11y/rustfs\"}[7d])))\nor label_replace(vector(0), \"job\", \"o11y/tempo\"\
          , \"\", \"\")"
        instant: true
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 600
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 1
            type: lt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: Error
    for: 5m
    labels: {}
    noDataState: Alerting
    title: Stack service down
    uid: o11y-service-down
  - annotations:
      description: Deploy refuses to start below this reserve. RustFS reports the
        free space of the filesystem it stores on.
      summary: The filesystem under the stack's data has less than 999999 GiB or 10
        percent free.
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: mimir
      model:
        expr: "(min by (job) (rustfs_cluster_capacity_free_bytes{job=\"o11y/rustfs\"\
          }) < bool 1073740750258176) + (min by (job) (rustfs_cluster_capacity_free_bytes{job=\"\
          o11y/rustfs\"})\n  < bool 0.1 * max by (job) (rustfs_cluster_capacity_usable_total_bytes{job=\"\
          o11y/rustfs\"}))"
        instant: true
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 600
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 0
            type: gt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: KeepLast
    for: 5m
    labels: {}
    noDataState: OK
    title: Disk free below the reserve
    uid: o11y-disk-low
  - annotations:
      description: A backend discarded samples, spans or log lines it received, or
        Alloy refused them at its receivers, usually under memory pressure.
      summary: '{{ $labels.job }} dropped data in the last 10 minutes: {{ $labels.reason
        }}.'
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: mimir
      model:
        expr: "sum by (job, reason) ((loki_discarded_samples_total{job=\"o11y/loki\"\
          }\n  unless loki_discarded_samples_total{job=\"o11y/loki\"} offset 10m)\n\
          \  or increase(loki_discarded_samples_total{job=\"o11y/loki\"}[10m])) >\
          \ 0\nor sum by (job, reason) ((cortex_discarded_samples_total{job=\"o11y/mimir\"\
          }\n  unless cortex_discarded_samples_total{job=\"o11y/mimir\"} offset 10m)\n\
          \  or increase(cortex_discarded_samples_total{job=\"o11y/mimir\"}[10m]))\
          \ > 0\nor sum by (job, reason) ((tempo_discarded_spans_total{job=\"o11y/tempo\"\
          }\n  unless tempo_discarded_spans_total{job=\"o11y/tempo\"} offset 10m)\n\
          \  or increase(tempo_discarded_spans_total{job=\"o11y/tempo\"}[10m])) >\
          \ 0\nor label_replace(sum by (job) ((otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}\n  unless otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total{job=\"o11y/alloy\"\
          } offset 10m)\n  or increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}[10m])) > 0,\n  \"reason\", \"refused spans\", \"\", \"\")\n\
          or label_replace(sum by (job) ((otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}\n  unless otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"} offset 10m)\n  or increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}[10m])) > 0,\n  \"reason\", \"refused metric points\", \"\"\
          , \"\")\nor label_replace(sum by (job) ((otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}\n  unless otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"} offset 10m)\n  or increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records_total{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}[10m])) > 0,\n  \"reason\", \"refused log records\", \"\",\
          \ \"\")"
        instant: true
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 1200
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 0
            type: gt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: KeepLast
    for: 2m
    labels: {}
    noDataState: OK
    title: Ingest dropped
    uid: o11y-ingest-dropped
  - annotations:
      description: Past its mem_limit in compose.yaml the kernel kills RustFS, and
        every backend loses its object store.
      summary: RustFS has used more than 85 percent of its memory limit for 10 minutes.
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: mimir
      model:
        expr: max by (job) (rustfs_system_process_resident_memory_bytes{job="o11y/rustfs"})
          / 805306368
        instant: true
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 600
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 0.85
            type: gt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: KeepLast
    for: 10m
    labels: {}
    noDataState: OK
    title: RustFS memory high
    uid: o11y-rustfs-memory
  - annotations:
      description: 'Alloy lost data it had accepted, or is close to it: an exporter
        keeps giving up on batches, a queue keeps refusing them, or a queue is nearly
        full.'
      summary: '{{ $labels.component_id }}: {{ $labels.problem }}.'
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: mimir
      model:
        expr: "label_replace(max by (component_id) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\"}\n  / otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{job=\"o11y/alloy\"})\
          \ > 0.9,\n  \"problem\", \"queue over 90 percent full\", \"\", \"\")\nor\
          \ label_replace(\n  sum by (component_id) (increase({job=\"o11y/alloy\"\
          ,\n    __name__=~\"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_.*_total|prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total\"\
          \n  }[5m])) > 0\n  and sum by (component_id) (increase({job=\"o11y/alloy\"\
          ,\n    __name__=~\"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_.*_total|prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total\"\
          \n  }[5m] offset 5m)) > 0\n  and sum by (component_id) (increase({job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\",\n    __name__=~\"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_.*_total|prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total\"\
          \n  }[5m] offset 10m)) > 0,\n  \"problem\", \"export failed\", \"\", \"\"\
          )\nor label_replace(\n  sum by (component_id) (increase({job=\"o11y/alloy\"\
          ,\n    __name__=~\"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_(spans|metric_points|log_records)_total\"\
          \n  }[5m])) > 0\n  and sum by (component_id) (increase({job=\"o11y/alloy\"\
          ,\n    __name__=~\"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_(spans|metric_points|log_records)_total\"\
          \n  }[5m] offset 5m)) > 0\n  and sum by (component_id) (increase({job=\"\
          o11y/alloy\",\n    __name__=~\"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_(spans|metric_points|log_records)_total\"\
          \n  }[5m] offset 10m)) > 0,\n  \"problem\", \"queue full\", \"\", \"\")"
        instant: true
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 1200
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 0
            type: gt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: KeepLast
    for: 2m
    labels: {}
    noDataState: OK
    title: Alloy queue full or export failing
    uid: o11y-alloy-export
  - annotations:
      description: A service that logs in a loop fills the disk under Loki faster
        than retention frees it.
      summary: The stack has logged more than 50 lines a second to Loki for an hour,
        or Loki has not answered the query for an hour.
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: loki
      model:
        expr: sum(rate({service_namespace="o11y"}[5m])) or vector(0)
        queryType: instant
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 600
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 50
            type: gt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: Alerting
    for: 1h
    labels: {}
    noDataState: Alerting
    title: Stack log rate high
    uid: o11y-log-rate
- folder: o11y
  interval: 1m
  name: ca-backup
  orgId: 1
  rules:
  - annotations:
      description: On nas-a, check the 03:15 root cron entry in /etc/crontab. Review
        the last backup result, verify step-ca health, and check that the job can
        reach the metrics collector.
      summary: The CA backup on nas-a failed or has gone 26 hours without a success.
    condition: C
    data:
    - datasourceUid: mimir
      model:
        expr: ((max(last_over_time(ca_backup_last_run_failed{host="nas-a"}[26h]))
          or vector(0)) > bool 0) + (time() - (max(last_over_time(ca_backup_last_success_or_start_timestamp_seconds{
          host="nas-a"}[26h])) or vector(0)) >= bool 93600)
        instant: true
        refId: A
      refId: A
      relativeTimeRange:
        from: 600
        to: 0
    - datasourceUid: __expr__
      model:
        conditions:
        - evaluator:
            params:
            - 0
            type: gt
        expression: A
        refId: C
        type: threshold
      refId: C
    execErrState: KeepLast
    for: 0s
    labels:
      env: prd
      host: nas-a
      service: ca-backup
      severity: high
    noDataState: Alerting
    title: CA backup failed or overdue
    uid: ca-backup-unhealthy

apiVersion: 1
providers:
- allowUiUpdates: true
  disableDeletion: true
  folder: Agents
  folderUid: o11y-agents-folder
  name: agents
  options:
    path: /etc/o11y-grafana/dashboards/agents
  type: file
